title: Watch: Former Roanoker and Lakers coach J.J. Redick talks about returning to the Star City
text:
Los Angeles Lakers head coach and Cave Spring alumnus JJ Redick answers questions from reporters following his speech at the Summit Sportsplex on Wednesday in Roanoke.
